name: FlowField
src_typeComment: The actual flow-field algorithm — plain C# (no MonoBehaviour), so it's independently testable and reusable outside a scene context. Computes ONE shared field per goal cell via a uniform-cost breadth-first wave outward from the goal, then derives each cell's flow direction by pointing toward its lowest-cost neighbor. Many agents then each read GetDirection() for their own cell every frame — nobody runs an individual pathfind, which is the whole point versus per-agent A*/Dijkstra when a large number of agents share the same destination (RTS units, a Tower Defense swarm).

src_members.sig: public Vector2 GetDirection(Vector2Int cell) => InBounds(cell) ? directions[cell.x, cell.y] : Vector2.zero
src_members.name: GetDirection

src_members.sig: public float GetCost(Vector2Int cell) => InBounds(cell) ? costToGoal[cell.x, cell.y] : float.MaxValue
src_members.name: GetCost
